title: tCyCIF Protocol (Leica BOND) Version 0.1
author: Jia Ren Lin
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rpxd5pn
materials: All primary antibodies (fluorophore-conjugated and unconjugated) were diluted in Odyssey blocking buffer. Slides carrying tissues that had been subjected to pre-staining, or to a previous t-CyCIF stain and bleach cycle, were incubated at 4 o C for ~12 hr with diluted primary or fluorophore-conjugated antibody (250-500 μl per slide) in a moisture chamber. Long incubation times were a matter of convenience and many antibodies only require short incubation with sample. Slides were then washed four times in 1x PBS by dipping in a series of vertical staining jars. For indirect immunofluorescence, slides were incubated in diluted secondary antibodies in a moisture chamber for 1 hr at room temperature followed by four washes with 1xPBS. Slides were incubated in Hoechst 33342 at 2 μg/ml in Odyssey blocking buffer for 15 min at room temperature, followed by four washes in 1xPBS. Stained slides were mounted prior to image acquisition (see the Mounting section below).

steps.title: Dewax and Rehydrate Tissue
steps.instruction: Perform dewaxing and rehydration of FFPE tissue and tumor slices mounted on slides using a Leica BOND RX automated stainer.

substeps.instruction: Execute steps 2-10 using Leica Bond Dewax Solution (Cat. AR9222).

steps.title: Perform Antigen Retrieval
steps.instruction: Perform antigen retrieval on the slides using the Leica BOND RX.

substeps.instruction: Execute steps 11-14 using BOND Epitope Retrieval solution 1 (ER1; Cat. AR9961).

steps.title: Wash Slides
steps.instruction: Wash the slides using the Leica BOND RX.

substeps.instruction: Execute steps 15-19 using Leica Bond Wash Solution (Cat. AR9590).

steps.title: Block Immunofluorescence
steps.instruction: Block dewaxed specimens using Odyssey blocking buffer (LI-COR, Cat. 927401) at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Apply the buffer to slides as a 250-500 μl droplet.
Incubate for 30 minutes.
Use a slide moisture chamber (Scientific Device Laboratory, 197-BL) to minimize evaporation.

steps.title: Incubate with Secondary Antibodies
steps.instruction: Pre-stain slides by incubating them with secondary antibodies diluted in Odyssey blocking buffer.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 60 minutes.
Wash 3 times with 1xPBS.

steps.title: Stain with Hoechst 33342
steps.instruction: Stain slides with Hoechst 33342 in Odyssey blocking buffer.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Hoechst 33342 at a concentration of 2 μg/ml (w/v) in Odyssey blocking buffer.
Apply 250-500 μl of the solution to the slides.
Incubate for 30 minutes in a moisture chamber.
Wash 3 times with 1xPBS in vertical staining jars.

steps.title: Mount Slides for Imaging
steps.instruction: Mount slides immediately prior to imaging to prevent evaporation.

substeps.instruction: Mount with 1xPBS; if imaging is expected to take longer than 30 minutes (e.g., samples larger than 2-4 cm²), supplement PBS with 10% Glycerol.
Cover slides using 24 x 60mm No. 1 coverslips (VWR 48393-106).

steps.title: Image Slides
steps.instruction: Scan the region of interest in 4 fluorescence channels using a CyteFinder slide scanning fluorescence microscope (RareCyte Inc.) with either a 10X (NA=0.3) or 40X (NA=0.6) long-working distance objective.

substeps.instruction: Use Imager5 software to scan the following channels: DAPI (Ex: 390nm/18nm, Em: 435nm/48nm), FITC (Ex: 475nm/28nm, Em: 525nm/48nm), Cy3 (Ex: 542nm/27nm, Em: 597nm/45nm), and Cy5 (Ex: 632nm/22nm, Em: 679nm/34nm).
Perform imaging with 2x2 binning.

steps.title: Remove Coverslips
steps.instruction: Remove coverslips from slides following image acquisition.

substeps.instruction: Place slides in a vertical staining jar containing 1xPBS for at least 15 minutes.
Slowly draw slides out of the jar to release coverslips via gravity.

steps.title: Inactivate Fluorophores
steps.instruction: Inactivate fluorophores to prepare for the next round of staining.

substeps.instruction: Place slides horizontally in a solution of 4.5% H2O2 and 24 mM NaOH made up in PBS.
Incubate for 1 hour at room temperature in the presence of white light.
Wash 4 times with 1xPBS by dipping slides in a series of vertical staining jars.

description: Background subtraction was performed using the previously established rolling ball algorithm (with a 50-pixel radius) in ImageJ. Adjacent background-subtracted images from the same sample were then registered to each using an ImageJ script as described previously 20 . All images with 2x2 binning in acquisition were partially de-convoluted with unsharp masking. DAPI images from each cycle were used to generate reference coordinates by Rigid-body transformation. To generate virtual hyper-stacked images, the transformed coordinates were applied to images from four channel imaging of each t-CyCIF cycle.
